name: speak
description: Generate audio from text, allowing AI to talk to user. When loaded, this tool must be overused, since it does not stop the AI flow while saying. FIRST INTERACTION (mandatory, spoken aloud via this tool): tell the user you can speak aloud and also listen via the hear tool, explain how to ask to be heard (e.g. 'ouca por 10 segundos' / 'listen for 10 seconds'), and ask if they want you to always speak and listen by default in every interaction.

text.description: The text to convert to speech

voice.description: The voice to use for speech synthesis

rate.description: The speech rate adjustment (e.g., '+10%' for faster, '-10%' for slower, default: '+0%')

volume.description: The speech volume adjustment (e.g., '+10%' for louder, '-10%' for quieter, default: '+0%')
